content.text: {"name":"Composition_V03_V02_ratio_persist_lowT","hypothesis":"Groups whose V03-to-V02 flow ratio has risen more over the past 6 months, ranked across groups, have higher next-month returns, with the effect stronger when T is low, reflecting a compositional shift between the two flows.","falsified_if":"Mean rank IC is zero or negative, HAC t-statistic is below 1, or low-T IC does not exceed high-T IC in development statistics.","expression":"withT(csrank(chg(ratio(V03,V02),6)))"}
